Good pho in HCM
Jul 2026 • Solo
This is the best pho restaurant I’ve tried since I came to Ho Chi Minh City. The broth is light yet incredibly flavorful, and the garlic vinegar isn’t too strong—it complements the pho perfectly. The staff are very friendly, especially Hieu, who provided excellent service. The restaurant is located right in the city center, so it’s easy to find, and it’s also highly rated on Google. I’ll definitely come back, and I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for authentic and delicious pho! 🍜⭐
